title: Cute decor
text: Cute decor. These are so cute. Will look nice hanging in my kitchen above my stove. They are thick and a pretty good size to protect your hands from getting burnt. With the ghost mitts shape, it can be used by a lefty or right hand and the design would still be on the outside and wouldnt get dirty if you happen to spill on it as you use it.

product_metadata.title: DII Halloween Cooking & Baking Collection Kitchen Accessories, Potholder & Oven Mitt Set, Ghost & Pumpkin, 2 Piece
features: FESTIVE AND FUNCTIONAL: Set includes 1 Oven Mitt 6.5x12" and 1 Potholder 8x8.5"; both are 100% cotton and machine washable for easy care for daily use
